recommendations.section: ## 6. Evidence Quality and Measurement Caveats — ### E. What becomes measurable next
recommendations.current: Three dated developments would change what this question can be answered with. A YouTube channel census built from 1.21 billion Internet Archive captures, covering at least 106 million unique channels with subscriber histories back to 2006, is public and has not yet carried a survival model — though its coverage bias correlates with subscriber count and would undercount small-channel deaths, where attrition is highest [[tube-census]]. Indonesia's 2026 Economic Census is billed as the first national instrument to enumerate content-creator business actors [[bps-dan-kemenekraf-bersinergi-kreator-lokal-dilibatkan-dalam-sosialisasi-se2026]], and the standard due at the 22nd International Conference of Labour Statisticians in 2028 would make national platform-work counts comparable for the first time [[ilo-brief]]. Until one lands,
recommendations.recommended:
Three dated developments would change what this question can be answered with:

- A **YouTube channel census** built from 1.21 billion Internet Archive captures, covering at least 106 million unique channels with subscriber histories back to 2006, is public and has not yet carried a survival model — though its coverage bias correlates with subscriber count and would undercount small-channel deaths, where attrition is highest [[tube-census]].
- **Indonesia's 2026 Economic Census** is billed as the first national instrument to enumerate content-creator business actors [[bps-dan-kemenekraf-bersinergi-kreator-lokal-dilibatkan-dalam-sosialisasi-se2026]].
- The **standard due at the 22nd International Conference of Labour Statisticians in 2028** would make national platform-work counts comparable for the first time [[ilo-brief]].

Until one lands,
recommendations.rationale: The closing forward-look enumerates three dated instruments of unequal length; as prose the third is compressed into a subordinate clause and loses visual weight.
